text:
For most of the first month and a half, Timo Meier did everything but score. Now it's turning: goals in four straight games, a five-game point streak, and Mike Fink of The Hockey News calling it a heater. He has seven goals and 13 points in 24 games.

Our numbers still list him as due. He has 91 shots and 10.0 expected goals, so seven goals is still behind, and the Devils have scored 5.7 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. The play itself is excellent: New Jersey takes 59% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) puts him at the 87th percentile among forwards for chances from the home plate, and he's physical (39 hits). He plays only 16:50 a night, middle-six minutes for a player paid like a first-liner. Our range projects 38 to 56 points, but 22 to 35 goals. If the shooting keeps catching up, the minutes should follow.
